proposals.evidence: Full tara section 1 explicitly records Bshk tar and Tor ta star. These directly support Bashkarik tar with source glottalization and Torwali tha with aspiration retained. The survey spelling does not establish a separate etymon; local phonetic development remains qualified. Exact response: tʰā.
